subject: Observability retention windows & trace sampling — pricing options and trade-offs
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@cloudscale.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons — retention / tracing / dashboards (options)

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the time last week — good to hear about CloudScale's ingestion peaks and compliance window needs. I promised to summarize our add-on options for observability and outline trade-offs so you can share with procurement. High level:

- Retention buckets: 90d, 365d, and 3-year archival. Pricing is tiered by GB-month; longer windows have a modest surcharge beyond 90d.
- Tracing: full-span capture vs sampled-only. Full capture increases storage and ingestion compute; we offer a mid-tier (adaptive sampling) that keeps distributed traces for 30d and indexes errors for 365d.
- Advanced dashboards: premium widgets (trace waterfall, request heatmaps), and seat-based maintenance for editors.

I attached a simple cost model and a short example of trace sampling profiles. Quick ask: can you confirm the expected monthly ingest (avg GB/day) and whether your compliance team requires 365d searchable traces or if archived cold storage is acceptable?

If you want, we can propose a 12-month committed package with a commercial concession (discount or one-time onboarding credit) in exchange for a longer commit. I want to align internally before we send something formal.

Best,
Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: redwood-retention-cost-model.xlsx (spreadsheet), trace-sampling-examples.json (json)
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@cloudscale.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Morgan Li <morgan.li@cloudscale.com>, procurement@cloudscale.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention / tracing / dashboards (options)

Hi Aisha,

Thanks — that helped. A few clarifying items from our side:

1) Monthly ingest: roughly 1.2 TB/day of logs+metrics, ~120GB/day of traces (peak bursts double that).
2) Compliance: security requires 365 days of searchable traces for high-risk endpoints, but we could archive less-critical traces to cold storage if searchable retention is reduced.
3) Dashboard seats: we only need 5 active editors but want 20 view-only users.

Commercial ask: if we commit to a 12-month reserved package for the hosted API (baseline commit) + add observability 365d retention and the adaptive tracing tier, what is the best discount you can offer? Our procurement team will likely push for a single consolidated PO.

Appreciate a clear line-item table so procurement can plug numbers into their template.

- Alex
Alex Chen
Head of Platform Engineering, CloudScale Labs
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: CloudScale — retention/tracing commercial question (need pricing input)

Ben / Karthik —

Looping you in. CloudScale provided ingest numbers (1.2TB/day logs+120GB/day traces) and wants 365d searchable traces for high-risk endpoints plus adaptive sampling elsewhere. They also asked about a 12-month commit discount for the platform + observability add-ons.

Suggested starting commercial position I drafted for internal review:
- Retention (365d searchable): list price $0.30 / GB-month; propose committed rate $0.24 / GB-month (20% off) for 12-month term.
- Adaptive tracing tier: list price $0.45 / GB-month for indexed traces; propose $0.36 / GB-month (20% off).
- Dashboard advanced: $40 / editor seat / month; propose 3 editor seats included for first 6 months and $30 / additional editor seat thereafter. View-only users are free.
- One-time onboarding credit: $10k credit to offset migration and sampling tuning.

Constraints / asks: are we comfortable with 20% off on the observability skus plus a $10k credit? If not, what's the counter? They want a single PO/quote.

Thanks,
Aisha
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: CloudScale — retention/tracing commercial question (need pricing input)

Aisha / Ben —

Technical context on cost drivers:
- At 120GB/day traces (~3.6TB/month), 365d searchable means ~1.3TB * 365 = ~1.3PB-year of indexed storage across traces/logs (gross simplification but helps model). Adaptive sampling reduces retained indexed volume by ~60% for non-critical endpoints.
- For CloudScale's bursty pattern, recommend: keep full capture (indexed) for the 25% of endpoints that are high-risk; apply adaptive sampling for others with a 10-15% capture window to retain fidelity for anomalies. This aligns with 365d searchable only where needed.

On pricing: a 20% committed discount across observability skus with a $10k onboarding credit is technically safe if we require commit terms and include a SLO for ingestion bursts (burst caping rules) to protect runtime. We should add an overage rate (1.5x list) above committed ingest thresholds.

I've attached a quick cost projection and two sampling profiles that we can include as examples in the proposal.

- Karthik
Attachments: redwood-retention-cost-model.xlsx, trace-sampling-examples.json
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: CloudScale — retention/tracing commercial question (need pricing input)

Team —

I approve a commercial package with constraints:
- Approve 15% discount across observability skus (retention + tracing) off list, not 20%. We can offer 20% only if they increase the platform commit by +25% (we should call this out).
- Approve $7,500 onboarding credit (reduced from $10k) tied to signed SOW and completion of migration runbook.
- Dashboard seats: include 2 editor seats free for 6 months; additional seats at $35 / month.
- Overage policy: 1.5x list rate after 120% of committed ingest allowance; billing cycles monthly.

Aisha — please convert to a formal quote and include the DocuSign link. Mention the overage protection and the requirement for a consolidated PO. Keep the language clear for procurement.

Thanks,
Ben

To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@cloudscale.com>

Subject: Commercial proposal — CloudScale observability add-ons (12-month commit)

Hi Alex / Morgan / procurement team,

Thanks for the details — attached is our formal proposal and a one-page cost table for procurement. Key points (summary):

- Term: 12 months (consolidated PO for platform + observability add-ons).
- Retention (365d searchable): $0.255 / GB-month (15% off list).
- Adaptive tracing tier (indexed): $0.3825 / GB-month (15% off list).
- Dashboard advanced: 2 editor seats included for 6 months; additional editor seats $35 / month; view-only users at no charge.
- Onboarding credit: $7,500 (applied after SOW signed and migration runbook accepted).
- Overage & burst policy: 1.5x list rate applies after 120% of committed ingest allowance; we will include an alerting trigger at 100% to avoid surprises.

Attached: proposal-cloudscale-2027-06-07.pdf (formal quote), redwood-retention-cost-model.xlsx (line-item projection), trace-sampling-examples.json (sampling profiles).

Next steps:
1) If this is acceptable, please confirm and we will send a DocuSign quote and SOW for signature.
2) Procurement can consolidate into a single PO referencing deal RDI-2027-331.
3) Karthik will coordinate sampling profiles and onboarding runbook on signature.

Open to a short call if you want to walk through the table in detail.

Best regards,
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
